$comment: This file is generated from TypeScript source. Do not edit it manually; run npm run generate:schemas.

serviceTier.description: Processing tier: "fast", "default", OpenAI-only "flex", or "ultrafast" (sent verbatim). "fast" also enables Anthropic fast mode on supported first-party models.

modelThinkingLevels.description: Per-model default thinking level overrides keyed by "provider/modelId".

sessionShareDestination.description: Destination used by /share. "auto" uses Radius when authenticated and otherwise creates a GitHub gist.

keepRecentTokens.description: Recent tokens retained without summarization. Unset means adaptive: max(20000, 10% of the effective context window).

softCeilingTokens.description: Caps the context window compaction thresholds use; 0 uses the raw model window. Unset falls back to PI_COMPACTION_SOFT_CEILING_TOKENS. A model's compaction.softCeilingTokens in models.json wins.

model.description: Summarization model as "provider/modelId[:thinkingLevel]". Default: the session model, or a Sonnet summarizer when the context-aware compaction ladder is on.

modelOverrides.description: Per-model overrides keyed by exact "provider/modelId" strings.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the prompt and LLM response.

skipPrompt.description: When true, skips the "Summarize branch?" prompt and defaults to no summary.

baseDelayMs.description: Exponential backoff base delay in milliseconds: 2s, 4s, 8s.

timeoutMs.description: SDK or provider request timeout in milliseconds.

maxDelayMs.description: Legacy retry delay setting. Use provider.maxRetryDelayMs instead.

watchdogEnabled.description: Enable semantic liveness supervision. false disables all watchdog and default-budget kills.

stallSoftMinutes.description: Minutes of parsed-event silence while awaiting model output before a run is flagged. Default: 5.

stallHardMinutes.description: Stream hard fuse in minutes; floored by max(15, 3x streamIdleTimeoutMs), or soft-only when that guard is off. Default: 21.

toolStallSoftMinutes.description: Parsed-event silence threshold in minutes while a tool execution is outstanding (quiet builds are legitimate). Default: 20.

toolStallHardMinutes.description: Hard kill threshold in minutes while a tool execution is outstanding. Default: 60.

maxRunMinutes.description: Default wall-clock budget per subagent run, in minutes. Soft: only idle children are killed; 0 disables. Default: 120.

toolMaxMinutes.description: Wall-clock ceiling for a single tool call inside a subagent, in minutes, even while it streams output. Floored at toolStallHardMinutes; 0 disables. Default: 90.

maxHardRunMinutes.description: Absolute wall-clock ceiling for a subagent run without an explicit timeoutSeconds, in minutes. Kills even a producing child; floored at maxRunMinutes; 0 disables. Default: 360.

childIsolation.description: Run each child in its own systemd-run --user --scope cgroup (Linux only) so a runaway fan-out cannot OOM the parent. "auto" uses it whenever the host can; "off" spawns children directly.

childMemoryMax.description: MemoryMax for each child cgroup: bytes, "8G", "512M", or a share of host RAM like "25%". 0 or "off" removes the ceiling. Default: 30% of RAM, clamped to 2-16 GiB.

childCpuCores.description: Whole CPUs each child cgroup may use (CPUQuota); also exported to the child as VITEST_MAX_THREADS and PYTEST_XDIST_AUTO_NUM_WORKERS. 0 or "off" removes it. Default: max(4, CPUs / 6).

default.description: Model for subagent tasks that name none (and whose agent definition names none), e.g. "example/model:high". PHI_SUBAGENT_MODEL_DEFAULT overrides it.

allow.description: Model patterns subagents may use: "provider/id", "provider/id:level", "provider/id:l1|l2", with * globs ("example/model:high"). A call with any task outside the list is refused. PHI_SUBAGENT_MODEL_ALLOW (comma-separated) overrides it.

models.description: Pin the models the subagent tool may launch and the default for tasks that name none.

subagents.description: Liveness watchdog, budgets and isolation for subagent child processes.

enabled.description: Join other local UI sessions and offer the agent_list and agent_message tools.
Escalate to the next model in chain when a safety classifier declines a turn.

chain.description: Ordered "provider/modelId" refs, best model first. Rungs naming an unknown model or a provider without auth are skipped.

sticky.description: Stay on the model that answered for the rest of the session; false restores the head of the chain after each escalated turn.

refusalFallback.description: Client-side model escalation for safety-classifier refusals.

enabled.description: Reroute to the next model in chain when the provider is down, unreachable, or out of quota. Defaults to false when a host UI owns model selection (RPC mode).

chain.description: Ordered "provider/modelId" refs, best model first. Rungs naming an unknown model or a provider without auth are skipped.

sticky.description: Stay on the fallback model for the rest of the session; false restores the selected model after each rerouted turn.

errorFallback.description: Client-side model rerouting for provider outages.

showCacheMissNotices.description: Show cache cost and provider recovery notices.

externalEditor.description: Command for Ctrl+G external editor; takes precedence over VISUAL and EDITOR.

shellPath.description: Custom shell path, for example for Cygwin on Windows, with support for leading ~ expansion.

quietStartup.description: When true, hide all startup output. When "header", keep only the startup header.

shellCommandPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every bash command, for example to enable shell aliases.

npmCommand.description: Command used for npm package lookup and installation, in argv form such as ["mise", "exec", "node@20", "--", "npm"].

collapseChangelog.description: Show the condensed changelog after update; use /changelog for the full changelog.

autoUpdate.description: Install newer phi releases from a configured self-hosted update feed automatically, without running /upgrade. The new release takes effect when phi restarts.

enableInstallTelemetry.description: Send an anonymous version and update ping to pi.dev after changelog-detected updates. Off in phi; PI_TELEMETRY=1 also opts in.

enableAnalytics.description: Opt in to analytics data sharing.

trackingId.description: Analytics tracking identifier, generated when analytics is enabled.

anyOf.description: Load all resources from the package.

autoload.description: When false, start empty and only apply explicit resource patterns.

items.description: Package source for npm or git packages. Use the string form to load all resources or the object form to filter resources.

packages.description: npm or git package sources, as strings or objects with resource filtering.

extensions.description: Local extension file paths or directories.

deviceId.description: Stable installation UUID, generated when authentication first needs it. Global only.

skills.description: Local skill file paths or directories.

prompts.description: Local prompt template file paths or directories.

themes.description: Local theme file paths or directories.

showImages.description: Show images when the terminal supports them.

imageWidthCells.description: Preferred inline image width in terminal cells.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear empty rows when content shrinks.

autoResize.description: Fit images to Claude's native resolution (2576px long edge) before sending; smaller images pass through untouched.

blockImages.description: When true, prevents all images from being sent to LLM providers.

enabledModels.description: Model patterns for cycling, in the same format as the --models CLI flag.

defaultTools.description: Initial tool selection. Plain names replace the inherited selection; +name and -name entries add or remove tools.

doubleEscapeAction.description: Action for double-escape with an empty editor.

thinkingBudgets.description: Custom token budgets for thinking levels.

editorPaddingX.description: Horizontal padding for the input editor.

toolOutputLines.description: Output lines shown per tool result while collapsed, clamped from 0 to 200; 0 shows only the expand hint. ctrl+o always expands.

toolDisplay.description: How much of a tool call and result is shown while collapsed. "minimal": intent line plus a one-line summary. "compact": short previews. "full": like compact, but sessions start expanded. ctrl+o always expands.

autocompleteMaxVisible.description: Maximum visible items in the autocomplete dropdown.

showHardwareCursor.description: Show the terminal cursor while still positioning it for IME.

mode.description: How codemode presents tools. "on" keeps direct tools declared and annotates tools callable from scripts; codemode lists only tools without direct exposure. "only" lists every script-callable tool in codemode and does not declare active direct tools.

inlineBudget.description: Estimated tokens available for inline codemode tool declarations.

sessionDir.description: Custom session storage directory, in the same format as the --session-dir CLI flag.

httpProxy.description: Proxy URL applied as HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY for Pi-managed HTTP clients.

httpIdleTimeoutMs.description: HTTP header or body idle timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

streamIdleTimeoutMs.description: Raw model-stream inactivity timeout in milliseconds before the request is aborted and retried; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

cacheWarming.description: Cache-warming profile. "idle" also warms between agent runs. Global only because each refresh costs money.

websocketConnectTimeoutMs.description: WebSocket connect or open handshake timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

uiMode.description: Legacy spelling of tuiMode written by phi 0.83 and earlier; read as a fallback.

fullscreenExitOutput.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenScrollbar.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenCopyOnSelect.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenWheelScrollLines.description: Lines scrolled per wheel event in fullscreen mode; numeric values are clamped from 1 to 100.

model.description: Model for side queries, as "provider/modelId" or "provider/modelId:thinking". Default: the current session model.

persist.description: Append completed answers to the TUI transcript as non-context entries.

maxHistory.description: Maximum Q&A pairs kept in the in-memory side thread; oldest pairs drop first. Clamped from 1 to 100.

maxWallTimeMs.description: Wall-time cap in milliseconds, up to 24 hours.

maxCostUsd.description: Spend cap in USD; unset means unlimited.

checkTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for each --check command in milliseconds.

evaluatorModel.description: Model that judges --until conditions. Default: the session model.

evaluatorConfidence.description: Confidence the evaluator needs to stop the loop, clamped from 0.5 to 1.

maxCheckOutputBytes.description: Check output kept per iteration, clamped from 1 KiB to 1 MiB.

classifier.description: How the end state is classified. "llm" spends an isolated side-question call; "heuristic" inspects the final message locally and handles side-call failures.
